rootCause: Catalog browsing incorrectly required nonempty element-level semantic usage tags. Nine published packs contained 1194 technically ready files, but all were unclassified (usageTags=[], usageTagsMode=inherit), so both SQL and TypeScript catalog paths reported zero. Existing audio semantic processing does not supply these tags.

minimalFix.catalog: Allow missing semantic tags for browsing only; preserve technical checks and manual-only exclusion. Keep unclassified usageTags empty.
minimalFix.semanticMatching: Unchanged; unclassified resources are not asserted to match a game role.
minimalFix.database: Applied 20261015010000_resource_catalog_browse_unclassified.sql through the user-authorized Chrome Supabase SQL Editor. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW only; no element or pack DML.
minimalFix.cliHelp: Clarifies technically browsable counts and empty usageTags.
